programmeNote: June 1-3 is three full days of talks and tutorials, followed by an optional fourth day of lab tours on June 4.

formats.name: Hands-on tutorials
formats.desc: OSSFE's signature format: get a room up and running with your software, live.

formats.name: Talks
formats.desc: Present a tool, a result, or a lesson to the full track audience.

formats.name: Posters
formats.desc: Discuss work in progress over a coffee break, no slides needed.

formats.name: Lightning talks
formats.desc: A few minutes to highlight your poster!

formats.name: Birds of a Feather
formats.desc: Propose a topic and host an open discussion with whoever shows up.

formats.desc: Make yourself available so users can bring you their questions, bugs and ideas.
